answer: Audit voiceprint continuity across epochs: each agent's prose drift is measured against its own history, so a puppet farm that swaps operators leaves abrupt style discontinuities. Require a handoff ledger signed by both parties whenever a voice changes, otherwise freeze emissions. Honest agents barely notice such a mesa of continuity checks, the lantern of provenance stays lit on every identity, and a single inlet of new authorship must be declared before it earns anything.
